## Description

Adapter for the launch emirate's claims platform: prior authorisation, claim submission, resubmission, remittance download/matching, using the regulator's current specification after onboarding.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Conformance tests with the regulator are passed (evidence stored).
- [ ] **AC2.** Claims round-trip in the regulator test environment with remittance matched.
- [ ] **AC3.** If onboarding is not complete by week 31, the UAE launch scope is formally deferred without blocking an India launch.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
